settings.repere: Paragraphe · Chef Zach Lutton is the founder and CEO
settings.text: Chef Zach Lutton is the founder and CEO of Zedric’s, a San Antonio-based meal prep company redefining what healthy eating can taste like.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · A graduate of the Culinary Institute of
settings.text: A graduate of the Culinary Institute of America in Hyde Park, New York, Zach began his career with Compass Group, working as a Chef across Bon Appétit and Eurest Dining to open and support food service operations. While working full-time in 2008, he started cooking meals out of his home for friends and local CrossFit athletes. By 2010, demand made the decision clear—Zedric's opened its first location.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Today, as CEO, Zach remains deeply invol
settings.text: Today, as CEO, Zach remains deeply involved in every part of the business—from culinary innovation and menu development to marketing, e-commerce, vendor partnerships, and operations—scaling a company built on real food, real ingredients, and a commitment to doing things the right way.
